title: Transitrix shared human-gate admission decision package
description: One accept/reject/defer decision per row, recorded against a review-queue.yaml (ingest) or review-digest.yaml (reg-intel) presentation artifact. Never canon itself (gate.admits_to_canon is always false); @transitrix/decisions-cli's `apply` command is what performs the CONTRACT §6.1 admission transition this file records. Absence of a row for a given item_ref means undecided, never rejected. See hub ADR architecture/methodology/2026-07-28-ingest-admission-decision-contract.md.

generated_by.description: Tool or human identifier that wrote this package (e.g. @transitrix/decisions-cli).

org_root.description: Path to the adopter organisation root the source gate was built for.

as_of.description: Quoted ISO 8601 date this package was assembled or last updated.

source_gate.description: review-queue.yaml or review-digest.yaml — the presentation artifact this package answers. Lives beside it in the same batch directory.

gate.description: Invariant statement for auditors and tooling: this package itself is never canon.

decisions.description: One row per item a human has decided on. An item present in the source gate with no row here is undecided, not rejected.

item_ref.description: Identifies the candidate / segment / amendment this decision is against — the bare id for a review-digest.yaml item, or the candidate file reference for a review-queue.yaml item.

kind.description: Optional; aids apply routing (e.g. element, relation, segment, requirement, constraint, amendment).

by.description: Who made the decision — a human handle, or a tool id when reviewer_authority: ai_reviewed (CONTRACT ADMIT-007).

at.description: ISO-8601 date or timestamp the decision was made.

reason.description: Required for reject; recommended for defer; optional for accept.

reviewer_authority.description: Only meaningful when decision: accept — same tiers and write-authority rule as CONTRACT §6.2. Absent on accept means expert_confirmed (same default as §6.2). A tool may write ai_reviewed; only a human writes expert_confirmed.
